page.layout: One column of running text. A small note in the left margin, beside the lines "Jarnacium" to "Vonum". Running head at the top with the page number on the left. Catchword "CAP." at the lower right.

main_text.p: crudelitatis pleni, neque unquam sinent Principem eos permittentem in conscientia securum esse, tanquam ejus mali auctorem. Exemplum ejus memorabile suppeditat Historia Gallorum, quod accidit Henrici 2. Regis Galliarum tempore. Quiut permisit duellum quod minime debuit inter Vidum Cabotium Jarnacium,Thuan. histor. l,3. & Franciscum Vivonum Castaneum, viditque spectando provocatorem Ca-staneum cui favebat penetrabili corporis sectione transver-beratum occumbere, tantus ejus conscientiam perstrinxit, dolor, ut Sacramento confirmaverit, se posthac in monomachiam nunquam consensurum.

page.notes: Catchword "CAP." read at lower right. "Quiut" is printed without a space; I kept it as seen. Marginal reference "Thuan. histor. l,3." is printed in the left margin beside the line "Jarnacium"; I placed it at that point in the text, with the comma after "l" as printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout. Scan shows faint marks at the lower edge only, not transcribed.
